q25305.en: The braking systems of light vehicles are often fitted with a brake servo.

explain.short: Most cars have a brake servo. It adds force to your foot, so you brake well without pushing very hard.
explain.rule: The brake servo (servofreno) adds force to your foot using the vacuum made by the engine, so it works only with the engine running.
explain.trap: 'spesso' (often) is right: many light vehicles have it, not necessarily all.

sceneParams.caption: Most cars have a brake servo

q25306.en: In braking systems, the kinetic energy of the motor vehicle is turned into heat by friction.

explain.short: When you brake, the pads rub on the discs. The energy of the moving car becomes heat.
explain.rule: Brakes stop the car by friction: the energy of the moving car becomes heat, and the friction linings (guarnizioni) get the hottest.
explain.trap: 'energia cinetica' means the energy of movement; 'attrito' means friction.

q25307.en: The parts of the braking system most stressed by high temperatures are the friction linings.

explain.short: The friction linings (pads and shoes) rub on the discs or drums, so they get the hottest.
explain.rule: Brakes stop the car by friction: the energy of the moving car becomes heat, and the friction linings (guarnizioni) get the hottest.
explain.trap: 'guarnizioni di attrito' are the friction linings: the pads and shoes, not the fluid or the pipes.

sceneParams.caption: Friction linings get the hottest
lines: Linings rub to stop the car

q25308.en: The parking brake must be used to hold the vehicle still when parked or in emergency situations.

explain.short: The hand brake keeps the parked car from moving. If the main brakes fail, it can also help you stop.
explain.rule: The parking brake (freno di stazionamento, the hand brake) holds the parked car, also on slopes, and helps in an emergency. It is not for normal braking while driving.
explain.trap: 'o per situazioni di emergenza' (or for emergencies) is also correct.

q25309.en: The level of the hydraulic brake fluid must be checked periodically.

explain.short: Without enough brake fluid the brakes can fail. Check the level regularly.
explain.rule: The brake fluid (liquido dei freni) carries the force of the pedal to the wheels. Check its level regularly.
explain.trap: 'periodicamente' (regularly) is right: the level is never 'check-free'.

q25310.en: The parking brake must be able to hold the parked vehicle still even on sloping roads.

explain.short: A parked car on a hill must not roll away. The hand brake must be strong enough for slopes too.
explain.rule: The parking brake (freno di stazionamento, the hand brake) holds the parked car, also on slopes, and helps in an emergency. It is not for normal braking while driving.
explain.trap: 'anche su strade in pendenza' (even on slopes) is correct: that is exactly its job.

sceneParams.caption: Hand brake holds the car on a slope

q25311.en: The vacuum brake servo cannot work with the engine off.

explain.short: The servo uses the vacuum made by the running engine. With the engine off the pedal becomes hard and you brake less.
explain.rule: The brake servo (servofreno) adds force to your foot using the vacuum made by the engine, so it works only with the engine running.
explain.trap: 'a motore spento' (engine off): no engine, no vacuum, no help from the servo.

q25312.en: The parking brake must not be used for service braking.

explain.short: To slow down or stop while driving you use the foot brake. The hand brake is for parking.
explain.rule: The parking brake (freno di stazionamento, the hand brake) holds the parked car, also on slopes, and helps in an emergency. It is not for normal braking while driving.
explain.trap: 'frenatura di servizio' means normal braking while driving, done with the pedal.

sceneParams.caption: Normal braking: use the foot pedal

q25313.en: The braking circuit of light vehicles is a sealed circuit, so a periodic check of the hydraulic fluid level is not needed.

explain.short: The brake fluid level must always be checked. Leaks and wear of the pads lower the level.
explain.rule: The brake fluid (liquido dei freni) carries the force of the pedal to the wheels. Check its level regularly.
explain.trap: 'non è necessario' (not needed) is the false part: the check is always needed.

sceneParams.caption: Brake fluid always needs checks
lines: Sealed or not: check the fluid

q25314.en: The parking brake must be used for service braking on very steep roads, to reduce overheating of the brake parts.

explain.short: On steep descents you use a low gear (engine brake) to avoid overheating, not the hand brake.
explain.rule: On a long steep descent use a low gear (engine brake) and press the foot brake in short steps. Never drive with the hand brake partly on.
explain.trap: 'per la frenatura di servizio' is wrong: the hand brake is never for normal braking.

sceneParams.caption: Steep descent: low gear, not hand brake
lines: Hand brake is not for driving

q25315.en: The vacuum brake servo can work even with the engine off, as long as the ignition key is in.

explain.short: The servo needs vacuum from the running engine. The key alone does not make it work.
explain.rule: The brake servo (servofreno) adds force to your foot using the vacuum made by the engine, so it works only with the engine running.
explain.trap: 'purché sia inserita la chiave' (as long as the key is in) is the false part: the engine must run.

sceneParams.caption: The key is not enough: engine must run

q25316.en: In an emergency stop, the driver must quickly put the car in reverse gear.

explain.short: Reverse gear while moving forward can break the gearbox and make you lose control. Press the brake pedal hard.
explain.rule: In an emergency press the brake pedal hard. Never put the car in reverse while it moves forward.
explain.trap: 'inserire rapidamente la retromarcia' (quickly engage reverse) is dangerous and wrong.

sceneParams.caption: Emergency: press the brake, never reverse

q25318.en: Weak or unbalanced braking can be caused by air or vapour in the hydraulic brake circuit.

explain.short: Air or vapour can be squeezed, unlike fluid. The pedal goes soft and the brakes push less.
explain.rule: Weak or unbalanced braking comes from the brakes, the tyres or the load: air or vapour in the fluid, worn or overheated linings, unevenly worn discs or drums, different tyre pressures on one axle, too much or badly placed load.
explain.trap: 'aria o vapore' (air or vapour) in the fluid is a real cause of bad braking.

sceneParams.caption: Air in the brake fluid: soft pedal
lines: Air or vapour in the brake fluid

q25319.en: Weak or unbalanced braking can be caused by excessive wear of the brake linings.

explain.short: Worn linings (pads and shoes) have less material to grip. The brakes work less, or more on one side.
explain.rule: Weak or unbalanced braking comes from the brakes, the tyres or the load: air or vapour in the fluid, worn or overheated linings, unevenly worn discs or drums, different tyre pressures on one axle, too much or badly placed load.
explain.trap: 'consumo eccessivo delle guarnizioni frenanti' (very worn linings) is a real cause.

q25320.en: Weak or unbalanced braking can be caused by uneven wear of the drums or discs.

explain.short: Discs or drums worn unevenly do not touch the linings well. One wheel brakes differently from another.
explain.rule: Weak or unbalanced braking comes from the brakes, the tyres or the load: air or vapour in the fluid, worn or overheated linings, unevenly worn discs or drums, different tyre pressures on one axle, too much or badly placed load.
explain.trap: 'consumo irregolare' (uneven wear) of discs or drums is a real cause.

q25321.en: Weak or unbalanced braking can be caused by different inflation pressure in the tyres on the same axle.

explain.short: If the two tyres on one axle have different pressure, they grip differently. The car pulls to one side when braking.
explain.rule: Weak or unbalanced braking comes from the brakes, the tyres or the load: air or vapour in the fluid, worn or overheated linings, unevenly worn discs or drums, different tyre pressures on one axle, too much or badly placed load.
explain.trap: 'dello stesso asse' (on the same axle): left and right tyres must have the same pressure.

q25322.en: Weak braking can be caused by excessive heating of the brake linings.

explain.short: Very hot linings grip much less (brake fade). The car needs more space to stop.
explain.rule: Weak or unbalanced braking comes from the brakes, the tyres or the load: air or vapour in the fluid, worn or overheated linings, unevenly worn discs or drums, different tyre pressures on one axle, too much or badly placed load.
explain.trap: 'eccessivo riscaldamento' (overheating) is a real cause of weak brakes.

q25323.en: Weak or unbalanced braking can be caused by an excessive or badly distributed load.

explain.short: A heavy car needs more braking. A load on one side or at the back changes how each wheel brakes.
explain.rule: Weak or unbalanced braking comes from the brakes, the tyres or the load: air or vapour in the fluid, worn or overheated linings, unevenly worn discs or drums, different tyre pressures on one axle, too much or badly placed load.
explain.trap: 'carico eccessivo o mal ripartito' (too much or badly placed load) is a real cause.

sceneParams.caption: Heavy or badly placed load: worse braking
lines: Too much or badly placed load

q25324.en: Weak braking can be caused by excessive, repeated braking.

explain.short: Braking again and again heats the brakes too much. Hot brakes grip less.
explain.rule: Weak or unbalanced braking comes from the brakes, the tyres or the load: air or vapour in the fluid, worn or overheated linings, unevenly worn discs or drums, different tyre pressures on one axle, too much or badly placed load.
explain.trap: 'eccessive e ripetute frenate' (many repeated brakings) overheat the linings.

q25325.en: With unbalanced brakes, it can happen that only the wheels on one side lock when braking.

explain.short: Unbalanced brakes push harder on one side. Those wheels can lock while the others still roll.
explain.rule: With unbalanced brakes the wheels on one side can lock first, the car skids toward that side, and the tyres wear unevenly.
explain.trap: 'soltanto le ruote di un lato' (only one side) is exactly what unbalanced means.

q25326.en: With unbalanced brakes, it can happen that the vehicle skids when braking, heading toward the side of the wheel that locks first.

explain.short: The side that brakes more pulls the car. The car turns toward the wheel that locks first.
explain.rule: With unbalanced brakes the wheels on one side can lock first, the car skids toward that side, and the tyres wear unevenly.
explain.trap: 'verso il lato della ruota che si blocca per prima' (toward the side that locks first) is correct.

sceneParams.caption: Car pulls toward the locked wheel

q25327.en: With unbalanced brakes, irregular and uneven wear of the treads usually appears.

explain.short: Tyres that brake harder or lock wear more. So the treads wear unevenly.
explain.rule: With unbalanced brakes the wheels on one side can lock first, the car skids toward that side, and the tyres wear unevenly.
explain.trap: 'in genere' (usually) makes it a normal effect, which is correct.

q25328.en: Weak or unbalanced braking can be caused by excessive wear of the parking brake mechanisms.

explain.short: The parking brake is a separate system for parking. Its wear does not change how the foot brake works.
explain.rule: Only the service brakes, the tyres and the load decide how well the car brakes. The clutch, power steering, fuel type, parking brake or normal winter tyres do not make braking weak or unbalanced.
explain.trap: 'freno di stazionamento' (hand brake) is not the brake you use when driving.

sceneParams.caption: Hand brake wear does not affect braking
lines: Not a cause of bad braking

q25329.en: Weak or unbalanced braking can be caused by insufficient lubrication of the drums or discs.

explain.short: Discs and drums must be dry and clean to grip. Oil on them would make braking worse, not better.
explain.rule: Only the service brakes, the tyres and the load decide how well the car brakes. The clutch, power steering, fuel type, parking brake or normal winter tyres do not make braking weak or unbalanced.
explain.trap: 'insufficiente lubrificazione' is a trick: brakes are never lubricated.

sceneParams.caption: Discs and drums must stay dry
lines: Discs must be dry, no oil
Not a cause of bad braking

q25330.en: Weak or unbalanced braking can be caused by too much play in the clutch pedal.

explain.short: The clutch connects the engine to the wheels. It has nothing to do with the brakes.
explain.rule: Only the service brakes, the tyres and the load decide how well the car brakes. The clutch, power steering, fuel type, parking brake or normal winter tyres do not make braking weak or unbalanced.
explain.trap: 'pedale della frizione' is the clutch pedal, not the brake pedal.

sceneParams.caption: The clutch does not affect braking
lines: Not a cause of bad braking

q25331.en: Weak or unbalanced braking can be caused by power steering on vehicles with a small engine.

explain.short: Power steering only makes the steering wheel lighter. It does not change the brakes.
explain.rule: Only the service brakes, the tyres and the load decide how well the car brakes. The clutch, power steering, fuel type, parking brake or normal winter tyres do not make braking weak or unbalanced.
explain.trap: 'servosterzo' is power steering, not the brake servo (servofreno).

sceneParams.caption: Power steering does not affect braking
lines: Not a cause of bad braking

q25332.en: Weak or unbalanced braking can be caused by disc brakes on the rear axle.

explain.short: Disc brakes are a normal, good type of brake. Having them at the back is not a problem.
explain.rule: Only the service brakes, the tyres and the load decide how well the car brakes. The clutch, power steering, fuel type, parking brake or normal winter tyres do not make braking weak or unbalanced.
explain.trap: 'freni a disco sull'asse posteriore' (rear disc brakes) are normal on many cars.

sceneParams.caption: Rear disc brakes are normal
lines: Not a cause of bad braking

q25333.en: Weak or unbalanced braking can be caused by winter tyres fitted on all four wheels.

explain.short: Winter tyres on all four wheels is the correct way to fit them. The car stays balanced.
explain.rule: Only the service brakes, the tyres and the load decide how well the car brakes. The clutch, power steering, fuel type, parking brake or normal winter tyres do not make braking weak or unbalanced.
explain.trap: 'su tutte e quattro le ruote' (on all four wheels) is right, not a problem.

sceneParams.caption: Four winter tyres: correct and balanced
lines: Not a cause of bad braking

q25334.en: Weak or unbalanced braking can be caused by winter tyres used on roads without snow.

explain.short: Winter tyres also work on roads without snow, and they are the same on every wheel. They do not make braking unbalanced.
explain.rule: Only the service brakes, the tyres and the load decide how well the car brakes. The clutch, power steering, fuel type, parking brake or normal winter tyres do not make braking weak or unbalanced.
explain.trap: 'strade non innevate' (roads without snow): winter tyres are allowed and work there too.

sceneParams.caption: Winter tyres also work without snow
lines: Winter tyres on a dry road
Not a cause of bad braking

q25334.reviewNote: Official answer FALSE; in hot weather winter tyres can brake slightly longer, so the claim is debatable.

q25335.en: Weak or unbalanced braking can be caused by using methane-powered vehicles on mountain roads.

explain.short: The fuel type (methane, petrol, diesel) does not change the brakes.
explain.rule: Only the service brakes, the tyres and the load decide how well the car brakes. The clutch, power steering, fuel type, parking brake or normal winter tyres do not make braking weak or unbalanced.
explain.trap: 'alimentazione a metano' (methane fuel) has nothing to do with braking.

sceneParams.caption: Fuel type does not affect braking
lines: Not a cause of bad braking

q25336.en: With unbalanced brakes, overheating of the engine coolant usually occurs.

explain.short: The engine coolant cools the engine, not the brakes. Unbalanced brakes make the car pull to one side.
explain.rule: With unbalanced brakes the wheels on one side can lock first, the car skids toward that side, and the tyres wear unevenly.
explain.trap: 'liquido refrigerante del motore' is engine coolant: a different system.

sceneParams.caption: Coolant is for the engine, not brakes

q25337.en: On very steep descents it is good to drive with the hand brake partly on.

explain.short: A hand brake left partly on overheats the brakes. On a descent use a low gear and the foot brake.
explain.rule: On a long steep descent use a low gear (engine brake) and press the foot brake in short steps. Never drive with the hand brake partly on.
explain.trap: 'freno a mano inserito parzialmente' (hand brake half on) is wrong and dangerous.

sceneParams.caption: Descent: low gear, hand brake off

q25338.en: Changing the brake pads is a routine maintenance job that any driver can do.

explain.short: Brakes are vital for safety. Pads must be changed by a workshop that knows how.
explain.rule: Brakes are vital for safety: changing the brake pads is a job for a workshop (officina), not routine work for any driver.
explain.trap: 'qualunque conducente' (any driver) is the false part.

sceneParams.caption: Brake pads: change them at a workshop

q25339.en: The suspensions of a motor vehicle are placed between the frame and the wheels.

explain.short: Suspensions connect the wheels to the frame (telaio) and let the wheels move up and down.
explain.rule: Suspensions (sospensioni) sit between the frame and every wheel. They absorb bumps, keep the wheels on the road and make driving comfortable and safe, all the time.
explain.trap: 'tra il telaio e le ruote' (between frame and wheels) is exactly where they are.

sceneParams.caption: Suspensions: between frame and wheels
lines: Frame of the car on top

q25340.en: The suspensions of a motor vehicle serve to ensure good riding comfort.

explain.short: Suspensions absorb the bumps of the road, so the people inside travel comfortably.
explain.rule: Suspensions (sospensioni) sit between the frame and every wheel. They absorb bumps, keep the wheels on the road and make driving comfortable and safe, all the time.
explain.trap: 'confort di marcia' (riding comfort) is one of their jobs.

q25341.en: The suspensions of a motor vehicle serve to keep the wheels in contact with the road surface.

explain.short: On bumps the suspensions push the wheels down, so the tyres keep touching the road and gripping.
explain.rule: Suspensions (sospensioni) sit between the frame and every wheel. They absorb bumps, keep the wheels on the road and make driving comfortable and safe, all the time.
explain.trap: 'aderenti al fondo stradale' (in contact with the road) is correct and key for safety.

sceneParams.caption: Suspensions keep wheels on the road

q25342.en: The suspensions of a motor vehicle serve to soften the shocks from the unevenness of the ground.

explain.short: Holes and bumps hit the wheels. The suspensions absorb these hits before they reach the car.
explain.rule: Suspensions (sospensioni) sit between the frame and every wheel. They absorb bumps, keep the wheels on the road and make driving comfortable and safe, all the time.
explain.trap: 'smorzare gli urti' (soften the shocks) is their main job.

q25343.en: The suspensions of a motor vehicle help to make driving more comfortable and safe.

explain.short: Suspensions give comfort and keep the wheels gripping the road, so driving is also safer.
explain.rule: Suspensions (sospensioni) sit between the frame and every wheel. They absorb bumps, keep the wheels on the road and make driving comfortable and safe, all the time.
explain.trap: 'confortevole e sicura' (comfortable and safe): both are right.

q25345.en: The suspensions of a motor vehicle are usually on the front wheels, but not on the rear ones.

explain.short: Every wheel has a suspension, front and rear. All wheels must stay on the road.
explain.rule: Suspensions (sospensioni) sit between the frame and every wheel. They absorb bumps, keep the wheels on the road and make driving comfortable and safe, all the time.
explain.trap: 'ma non su quelle posteriori' (but not the rear ones) is the false part.

q25346.en: The suspensions of a motor vehicle serve to stiffen the vehicle, so the driver clearly feels every bounce caused by uneven road.

explain.short: Suspensions do the opposite: they absorb the bounces so the driver feels them less.
explain.rule: Suspensions (sospensioni) sit between the frame and every wheel. They absorb bumps, keep the wheels on the road and make driving comfortable and safe, all the time.
explain.trap: 'irrigidire' (to stiffen) is the opposite of what they do.

sceneParams.caption: Suspensions absorb bounces
lines: Not to make the car stiff

q25347.en: The suspensions of a motor vehicle do not work on a straight road.

explain.short: Even straight roads have bumps and holes. Suspensions work all the time, also when braking and accelerating.
explain.rule: Suspensions (sospensioni) sit between the frame and every wheel. They absorb bumps, keep the wheels on the road and make driving comfortable and safe, all the time.
explain.trap: 'non entrano in funzione' (do not work) is the false part.

q25348.en: Suspensions can become inefficient from wear or from very strong impacts.

explain.short: Like any part, suspensions wear out with use. A hard hit, like a deep hole, can damage them.
explain.rule: Suspensions are damaged by wear, strong impacts and overloading. Bad suspensions give poor road holding, less comfort, a tired driver and badly aimed headlights.
explain.trap: 'usura' (wear) and 'urti troppo forti' (very strong hits) are both real causes.

sceneParams.caption: Wear and hard hits damage suspensions

q25349.en: A vehicle with inefficient suspensions has road-holding problems.

explain.short: Bad suspensions let the wheels jump off the road. The car grips less, especially in bends and when braking.
explain.rule: Suspensions are damaged by wear, strong impacts and overloading. Bad suspensions give poor road holding, less comfort, a tired driver and badly aimed headlights.
explain.trap: 'tenuta di strada' (road holding) means how well the car stays on its path.

q25350.en: Overloading the vehicle can lead to the suspensions breaking.

explain.short: Too much weight pushes the suspensions beyond their limit. They can break.
explain.rule: Suspensions are damaged by wear, strong impacts and overloading. Bad suspensions give poor road holding, less comfort, a tired driver and badly aimed headlights.
explain.trap: 'può comportare' (can lead to) is correct: breaking is possible.

sceneParams.caption: Overload can break suspensions
lines: Too much load in the car

q25351.en: Overloading the vehicle can make the suspensions temporarily inefficient.

explain.short: With too much weight the suspensions are squeezed down and cannot absorb bumps well while the load is there.
explain.rule: Suspensions are damaged by wear, strong impacts and overloading. Bad suspensions give poor road holding, less comfort, a tired driver and badly aimed headlights.
explain.trap: 'temporanea' (temporary): while the car is overloaded they work badly.

sceneParams.caption: Overload: suspensions work badly
lines: Too much load in the car

q25352.en: Repeated overloading of the vehicle can lead to fast wear of the suspensions.

explain.short: Carrying too much weight again and again tires the suspensions. They wear out sooner.
explain.rule: Suspensions are damaged by wear, strong impacts and overloading. Bad suspensions give poor road holding, less comfort, a tired driver and badly aimed headlights.
explain.trap: 'ripetuto' (repeated) overload wears them out faster.

sceneParams.caption: Repeated overload: fast wear
lines: Too much load in the car

q25353.en: A vehicle with inefficient suspensions reduces riding comfort.

explain.short: Bad suspensions do not absorb bumps well. The people inside feel every hole.
explain.rule: Suspensions are damaged by wear, strong impacts and overloading. Bad suspensions give poor road holding, less comfort, a tired driver and badly aimed headlights.
explain.trap: 'riduce il confort' (reduces comfort) is a true effect.

q25354.en: A vehicle with inefficient suspensions increases the driver's tiredness.

explain.short: The driver feels more shaking and must correct the car more often, so they get tired sooner.
explain.rule: Suspensions are damaged by wear, strong impacts and overloading. Bad suspensions give poor road holding, less comfort, a tired driver and badly aimed headlights.
explain.trap: 'affaticamento' (tiredness) is a true effect.

q25355.en: A vehicle with inefficient suspensions can have wrongly aimed dipped headlights as a result.

explain.short: If the car sits too low at one end, the headlights point too high or too low. They can dazzle others or light too little.
explain.rule: Suspensions are damaged by wear, strong impacts and overloading. Bad suspensions give poor road holding, less comfort, a tired driver and badly aimed headlights.
explain.trap: 'anomalo orientamento' (wrong aim) of the 'anabbaglianti' (dipped beams) is a true effect.

sceneParams.caption: Bad suspensions: headlights aimed wrong
lines: Car sits too low at one end

q25356.en: Overloading the vehicle causes no problems for the suspensions.

explain.short: Too much weight can break the suspensions or make them wear fast.
explain.rule: Suspensions are damaged by wear, strong impacts and overloading. Bad suspensions give poor road holding, less comfort, a tired driver and badly aimed headlights.
explain.trap: 'non comporta problemi' (no problems) is the false part.

sceneParams.caption: Overload harms suspensions
lines: Too much load in the car

q25357.en: If the vehicle is overloaded, to avoid suspension problems it is enough to raise the tyre pressure by one bar.

explain.short: Tyre pressure does not carry the extra weight for the suspensions. The only fix is not to overload the car.
explain.rule: Overloading makes shock absorbers work badly and wear out early. Careful driving or more tyre pressure does not fix this.
explain.trap: 'è sufficiente' (it is enough) is the false part: more tyre pressure fixes nothing.

sceneParams.caption: More tyre pressure does not fix overload

q25358.en: The vehicle's suspensions must be replaced roughly every thirty thousand kilometres.

explain.short: There is no fixed distance. Suspensions are checked and replaced when they are worn or damaged.
explain.rule: Suspensions need regular checks at a workshop: there is no fixed change distance and no maintenance-free period. They also help steering, and even one broken suspension is dangerous.
explain.trap: 'ogni trentamila chilometri' (every 30,000 km) is an invented fixed rule.

sceneParams.caption: No fixed km: replace when worn

q25359.en: Overloading the vehicle makes driving more difficult, but causes no problems for the suspensions.

explain.short: The first part is true, but overload also damages the suspensions.
explain.rule: Suspensions are damaged by wear, strong impacts and overloading. Bad suspensions give poor road holding, less comfort, a tired driver and badly aimed headlights.
explain.trap: 'mentre non comporta problemi' (but no problems) is the false part.

sceneParams.caption: Overload: harder driving AND suspension damage

q25360.en: The suspensions of a motor vehicle, being made of elastic materials, are not damaged by the knocks they take while driving.

explain.short: Elastic parts still wear out and break. Strong knocks can damage the suspensions.
explain.rule: Suspensions are damaged by wear, strong impacts and overloading. Bad suspensions give poor road holding, less comfort, a tired driver and badly aimed headlights.
explain.trap: 'non subiscono danni' (are not damaged) is the false part.

q25361.en: The suspensions of a motor vehicle are made so they need no checks or maintenance for the whole warranty period.

explain.short: Suspensions need regular checks, also during the warranty. Damage can happen at any time.
explain.rule: Suspensions need regular checks at a workshop: there is no fixed change distance and no maintenance-free period. They also help steering, and even one broken suspension is dangerous.
explain.trap: 'non necessitare di verifiche' (need no checks) is the false part.

q25362.en: Suspensions do not help the vehicle's steering, because this is ensured only by the steering parts.

explain.short: To steer, the wheels must touch the road. Suspensions keep them on the road, so they help steering.
explain.rule: Suspensions need regular checks at a workshop: there is no fixed change distance and no maintenance-free period. They also help steering, and even one broken suspension is dangerous.
explain.trap: 'unicamente' (only) is the trap: steering also needs the suspensions.

q25363.en: Since cars have a suspension on each wheel, breaking just one of the four causes no driving problems.

explain.short: One broken suspension makes that wheel lose grip. The car becomes unstable and dangerous.
explain.rule: Suspensions need regular checks at a workshop: there is no fixed change distance and no maintenance-free period. They also help steering, and even one broken suspension is dangerous.
explain.trap: 'non comporta problemi' (no problems) is the false part.

q25364.en: The shock absorbers of a motor vehicle serve to reduce the oscillations of the suspensions.

explain.short: After a bump the springs keep bouncing. Shock absorbers stop this bouncing quickly.
explain.rule: Shock absorbers (ammortizzatori) stop the suspension springs from bouncing, so the wheels stay on the road. They help road holding (tenuta di strada).
explain.trap: 'oscillazioni' (bouncing) of the suspension springs is what they calm down.

q25365.en: Shock absorbers help the vehicle's road holding.

explain.short: By stopping the bouncing, shock absorbers keep the tyres on the road. The car grips better.
explain.rule: Shock absorbers (ammortizzatori) stop the suspension springs from bouncing, so the wheels stay on the road. They help road holding (tenuta di strada).
explain.trap: 'collaborano' (help) is correct: they work together with the suspensions and tyres.

q25366.en: Shock absorbers serve, among other things, to ensure the vehicle's road holding.

explain.short: Shock absorbers keep the wheels in contact with the road. That is road holding.
explain.rule: Shock absorbers (ammortizzatori) stop the suspension springs from bouncing, so the wheels stay on the road. They help road holding (tenuta di strada).
explain.trap: 'tra l'altro' (among other things): road holding is one of their jobs, with comfort.

q25367.en: Overloading the vehicle can make the shock absorbers inefficient.

explain.short: Too much weight squeezes the shock absorbers. They cannot control the bouncing well.
explain.rule: Overloading makes shock absorbers work badly and wear out early. Careful driving or more tyre pressure does not fix this.
explain.trap: 'può rendere inefficienti' (can make them work badly) is correct.

sceneParams.caption: Overload: shock absorbers work badly
lines: Too much load in the car

q25368.en: Overloading the vehicle can cause early wear of the shock absorbers.

explain.short: Carrying too much weight makes the shock absorbers work too hard. They wear out sooner.
explain.rule: Overloading makes shock absorbers work badly and wear out early. Careful driving or more tyre pressure does not fix this.
explain.trap: 'usura precoce' (early wear) is a true effect.

sceneParams.caption: Overload: shock absorbers wear early
lines: Too much load in the car

q25369.en: The shock absorbers of a motor vehicle need no checks or maintenance while the vehicle warranty lasts.

explain.short: Shock absorbers can wear or break at any time. They need checks, also during the warranty.
explain.rule: Shock absorbers need checks at a specialised workshop, also during the warranty. The driver cannot adjust their stiffness in every case.
explain.trap: 'non necessitano di verifiche' (need no checks) is the false part.

sceneParams.caption: Check shock absorbers, warranty or not

q25370.en: Overloading causes no problems to a motor vehicle's shock absorbers if the driver drives carefully.

explain.short: Careful driving does not remove the extra weight. Overload still harms the shock absorbers.
explain.rule: Overloading makes shock absorbers work badly and wear out early. Careful driving or more tyre pressure does not fix this.
explain.trap: 'se il conducente adotta uno stile di guida prudente' (if driving carefully) does not help.

sceneParams.caption: Careful driving does not fix overload

q25371.en: If the vehicle is overloaded, to avoid problems with the shock absorbers it is enough to raise the tyre pressure by half a bar.

explain.short: Tyre pressure does not protect the shock absorbers. The only fix is not to overload the car.
explain.rule: Overloading makes shock absorbers work badly and wear out early. Careful driving or more tyre pressure does not fix this.
explain.trap: 'è sufficiente' (it is enough) is the false part.

sceneParams.caption: More tyre pressure does not fix overload

q25372.en: The driver can in every case adjust the stiffness of the shock absorbers.

explain.short: Most cars have shock absorbers that the driver cannot adjust. Only some special cars allow it.
explain.rule: Shock absorbers need checks at a specialised workshop, also during the warranty. The driver cannot adjust their stiffness in every case.
explain.trap: 'in ogni caso' (in every case) is the false part.

q25373.en: The stiffness of a motor vehicle's shock absorbers can be checked by the owner, without going to a specialised workshop.

explain.short: Checking shock absorbers needs tools and skill. It is a job for a specialised workshop.
explain.rule: Shock absorbers need checks at a specialised workshop, also during the warranty. The driver cannot adjust their stiffness in every case.
explain.trap: 'senza ricorrere ad un'officina specializzata' (without a workshop) is the false part.

sceneParams.caption: Shock absorbers: check at a workshop

q25374.en: Worn shock absorbers cause abnormal behaviour of the vehicle when braking.

explain.short: With worn shock absorbers the car dives and bounces when braking. The wheels grip less and you stop later.
explain.rule: Worn shock absorbers (ammortizzatori scarichi) let the car bounce: worse road holding, strange behaviour when braking and in bends, uneven tyre wear, more risk of broken springs, less comfort.
explain.trap: 'scarichi' means worn out: they no longer stop the bouncing.

q25375.en: Worn shock absorbers cause abnormal behaviour of the vehicle, especially in bends.

explain.short: In a bend the car leans and bounces. The tyres lose grip and the car can leave its path.
explain.rule: Worn shock absorbers (ammortizzatori scarichi) let the car bounce: worse road holding, strange behaviour when braking and in bends, uneven tyre wear, more risk of broken springs, less comfort.
explain.trap: 'particolarmente in curva' (especially in bends) is correct.

sceneParams.caption: Worn shocks: danger in bends
lines: Car rolls and bounces in a bend

q25376.en: In a motor vehicle, worn shock absorbers cause uneven wear of the tyre treads.

explain.short: The bouncing wheel hits the road in jumps. The tread wears in patches.
explain.rule: Worn shock absorbers (ammortizzatori scarichi) let the car bounce: worse road holding, strange behaviour when braking and in bends, uneven tyre wear, more risk of broken springs, less comfort.
explain.trap: 'usura non uniforme' (uneven wear) of the tread is a true effect.

q25377.en: In a motor vehicle, worn shock absorbers increase the risk of the suspension springs breaking.

explain.short: Without good shock absorbers the springs bounce much more. This tires them and they can break.
explain.rule: Worn shock absorbers (ammortizzatori scarichi) let the car bounce: worse road holding, strange behaviour when braking and in bends, uneven tyre wear, more risk of broken springs, less comfort.
explain.trap: 'molle delle sospensioni' (suspension springs) work too hard without shock absorbers.

q25378.en: In a motor vehicle, worn shock absorbers reduce the passengers' riding comfort.

explain.short: The car keeps bouncing after every bump. The passengers feel it.
explain.rule: Worn shock absorbers (ammortizzatori scarichi) let the car bounce: worse road holding, strange behaviour when braking and in bends, uneven tyre wear, more risk of broken springs, less comfort.
explain.trap: 'diminuzione del comfort' (less comfort) is a true effect.

q25379.en: In a motor vehicle, worn shock absorbers make road holding worse.

explain.short: Bouncing wheels touch the road less. The car grips less.
explain.rule: Worn shock absorbers (ammortizzatori scarichi) let the car bounce: worse road holding, strange behaviour when braking and in bends, uneven tyre wear, more risk of broken springs, less comfort.
explain.trap: 'peggiorano la tenuta di strada' (worsen road holding) is correct.

q25380.en: In a vehicle, worn shock absorbers cause the engine to work abnormally.

explain.short: Shock absorbers work on the wheels, not on the engine. The engine is not affected.
explain.rule: Worn shock absorbers do not affect the engine or the oil. Every car has both suspensions (springs) and shock absorbers, and shock absorbers always need checks.
explain.trap: 'funzionamento del motore' (engine working) has nothing to do with shock absorbers.

sceneParams.caption: Shock absorbers do not affect the engine

q25381.en: In a motor vehicle, worn shock absorbers cause higher lubricant consumption.

explain.short: Engine oil use depends on the engine, not on shock absorbers.
explain.rule: Worn shock absorbers do not affect the engine or the oil. Every car has both suspensions (springs) and shock absorbers, and shock absorbers always need checks.
explain.trap: 'consumo di lubrificante' (oil use) has nothing to do with shock absorbers.

sceneParams.caption: Shock absorbers do not change oil use

q25382.en: In a motor vehicle, worn shock absorbers, by lowering the frame's height from the ground, improve road holding, especially in bends.

explain.short: Worn shock absorbers make road holding worse, especially in bends, not better.
explain.rule: Worn shock absorbers (ammortizzatori scarichi) let the car bounce: worse road holding, strange behaviour when braking and in bends, uneven tyre wear, more risk of broken springs, less comfort.
explain.trap: 'migliorano' (improve) is the false part: it is the opposite.

sceneParams.caption: Worn shocks make bends worse, not better

q25383.en: In a motor vehicle, shock absorbers can be replaced with a reinforced suspension.

explain.short: Springs and shock absorbers do different jobs. Stronger springs cannot replace shock absorbers.
explain.rule: Worn shock absorbers do not affect the engine or the oil. Every car has both suspensions (springs) and shock absorbers, and shock absorbers always need checks.
explain.trap: 'sostituiti con una sospensione rinforzata' is wrong: both parts are needed.

sceneParams.caption: Shock absorbers cannot be replaced by springs

q25384.en: A motor vehicle has suspensions or shock absorbers, but rarely both.

explain.short: Every car has both: springs that carry the weight and shock absorbers that stop the bouncing.
explain.rule: Worn shock absorbers do not affect the engine or the oil. Every car has both suspensions (springs) and shock absorbers, and shock absorbers always need checks.
explain.trap: 'difficilmente di tutti e due' (rarely both) is false: they always work together.

q25385.en: A vehicle's shock absorbers, if they are the sealed type, need no maintenance.

explain.short: Sealed shock absorbers cannot be refilled, but they still wear out. They need checks and replacement when worn.
explain.rule: Worn shock absorbers do not affect the engine or the oil. Every car has both suspensions (springs) and shock absorbers, and shock absorbers always need checks.
explain.trap: 'non necessitano di manutenzione' (need no maintenance) is the false part.
